## Add human gene symbols to the annotation 

code from https://www.r-bloggers.com/converting-mouse-to-human-gene-names-with-biomart-package/

```{r, eval = FALSE}
musGenes <- TOC$mgi_symbol
 
# Basic function to convert mouse to human gene names
convertMouseGeneList <- function(x){
 
require("biomaRt")
human = useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
mouse = useMart("ensembl", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl")
 
genesV2 = getLDS(attributes = c("mgi_symbol"), filters = "mgi_symbol", values = x , mart = mouse, attributesL = c("hgnc_symbol"), martL = human, uniqueRows=FALSE)
humanx <- unique(genesV2[, 2])
 
# Print the first 6 genes found to the screen
print(head(humanx))
return(genesV2)
}
mgi_to_hngc_symbol <- convertMouseGeneList(musGenes)
head(mgi_to_hngc_symbol)
```

join with the clinical data by study_ID 
```{r}
dim(human_mb_clinical)

human_ezh2_tx  <- left_join(human_ezh2_tx, human_mb_clinical, by = c("ptn" = "Study_ID"))



human_ezh2_tx$subtype <- human_ezh2_tx$Subgroup


human_ezh2_tx$EZH2 <- as.numeric(as.character(human_ezh2_tx$EZH2))


human_ezh2_tx_SHH <- human_ezh2_tx %>%
  dplyr::filter(subtype == "SHH") %>% 
  ungroup()

human_ezh2_tx_SHH <- human_ezh2_tx_SHH[order(human_ezh2_tx_SHH$EZH2),]
row.names(human_ezh2_tx_SHH) <- c(1:nrow(human_ezh2_tx_SHH))
human_ezh2_tx_SHH$rank <- c(1:nrow(human_ezh2_tx_SHH))
  
percentile.ranks <- function(vector, from=NA, to=NA, round=1){
    if(is.na(from)) from <- min(vector)
    if(is.na(to)) to <- max(vector)
    vector <- na.omit(vector)
    data.frame(
        value = from:to,
        perc.rank = round(100*sapply(from:to, function(x) length(vector[vector<=x])/length(vector)), round)
    )
}

ezh2_percentile <- percentile.ranks(human_ezh2_tx_SHH$rank)

human_ezh2_tx_SHH$percentile <- ezh2_percentile$perc.rank


human_ezh2_tx_SHH <- human_ezh2_tx_SHH %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(EZH2_high_low = case_when(
      percentile <= 30                    ~  "Ezh2 low",
      percentile >= 70                    ~  "Ezh2 high",
      percentile < 70 & percentile > 30   ~  "Ezh2 mid",
      TRUE                                ~  "other"

  ))
```

```{r rank_plor, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
hs_ezh2_de_genes_ez_low <- c("Gabra6", "Cbx7", "Phyhip", "Ablim1", "Cacna1a","Slc12a5" )
hs_ezh2_de_genes_ez_high <- c( "Atoh1", "Mycn","Ezh2","Top2a", "Melk","Cdk1")

histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_ez_de %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = diff_group, y = logFC )) + 
  geom_violin() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_ez_de <- histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_ez_de %>%
  mutate(Ezh2_de_group =  case_when(
      logFC >= log2(1.5) & adj.P.Val < 0.05   ~ "High_when_EZH2_low",
      logFC <= -log2(1.5) & adj.P.Val < 0.05   ~ "Low_when_EZH2_low",
      TRUE                           ~ "other"
    )) 

table(histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_ez_de$Ezh2_de_group)





histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_ez_de$Ezh2_de_group <- as.factor(histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_ez_de$Ezh2_de_group)




hs_ezh2_de_cols <- c("orange2", "navajowhite4", "grey70")
names(hs_ezh2_de_cols) <- levels(histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_ez_de$Ezh2_de_group)

histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_ez_de_rank <- histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_ez_de %>%
  dplyr::mutate( rank_id = dense_rank(logFC)) 
  
histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_ez_de_rank   %>%
  
ggplot(aes(x = rank_id, y = logFC, group= Ezh2_de_group, colour = Ezh2_de_group )) + 
  geom_point() + 
  labs(x = "Rank by Log2 Fold Change (FC)", 
         y = TeX("$log_2\\frac{$Expression Ezh2 low tumors (30%)$}{$Expression Ezh2 high tumors (30%)}"),
       colour = "Differential expressison" ) + 

  geom_text_repel(data =  subset(histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_ez_de_rank,  mgi_symbol %in% hs_ezh2_de_genes_ez_low), 
            aes(x = rank_id, y = logFC, label = hgnc_symbol), 
            nudge_x = -10,
            #  point.padding = 10,
           # box.padding = 1,
            min.segment.length = 0,
            force = 30,
            size = 4, 
            colour = "black") +
    geom_text_repel(data =  subset(histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_ez_de_rank,  mgi_symbol %in% hs_ezh2_de_genes_ez_high), 
            aes(x = rank_id, y = logFC, label = hgnc_symbol), 
            nudge_x = 10,
            #  point.padding = 10,
           # box.padding = 1,
            min.segment.length = 0,
            force = 30,
            size = 4, 
            colour = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = hs_ezh2_de_cols, 
                     labels = c("Genes increased when Ezh2 low", "Genes increased when Ezh2 high", "unchanged")) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme( 
    legend.position =  c(0.7, 0.2), 
    text = element_text(size = 14))



```

## Test differential expression using limma

```{r}
library(limma)
library(stringr)

# get names of SHH samples 
SHH_samples <- human_mb_clinical %>%
  dplyr::filter(Subgroup == "SHH") %>%
  dplyr::pull(Study_ID)
SHH_samples <- as.character(SHH_samples)



# get EZH2 high vs low groups 
Ezh2_top_bottom <- human_ezh2_tx_SHH %>%
  dplyr::filter(EZH2_high_low != "Ezh2 mid") %>%
  dplyr::select(ptn, EZH2_high_low)

table(Ezh2_top_bottom$EZH2_high_low)

# keep only SHH samples 
human_MB_SHH <- human_mb_raw_all %>%
    dplyr::select(Probe.Set.Name, contains("MB_SubtypeStudy")) %>%
    dplyr::select(Probe.Set.Name, one_of(Ezh2_top_bottom$ptn)  )


row.names(human_MB_SHH) <-  human_MB_SHH$Probe.Set.Name
human_MB_SHH$Probe.Set.Name <- NULL


Ezh2_meta <- plyr::mapvalues(colnames(human_MB_SHH), from =Ezh2_top_bottom$ptn, to = Ezh2_top_bottom$EZH2_high_low  )
Ezh2_meta <- as.factor(Ezh2_meta)
design <- data.frame(Ezh2_high = (Ezh2_meta == "Ezh2 high"), Ezh2_low =  (Ezh2_meta == "Ezh2 low"))
design <- as.matrix(design) *1

fit <- lmFit(human_MB_SHH, design)
#contrast <- makeContrasts(P7 - P21, levels = design)
#fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
Ezh2_high_low <- topTable(fit2,sort="none",n=Inf)


Ezh2_high_low_de <- Ezh2_high_low
Ezh2_high_low_de$Probe.Set.Name <- row.names(Ezh2_high_low_de)

Ezh2_high_low_de <- Ezh2_high_low_de %>%
  dplyr::mutate(EZH2_logFC = Ezh2_low - Ezh2_high) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Ezh2_de_group =  case_when(
      EZH2_logFC >= log2(1.4) & adj.P.Val < 0.05   ~ "High_when_EZH2_low",
      EZH2_logFC <= -log2(1.4) & adj.P.Val < 0.05   ~ "Low_when_EZH2_low",
      TRUE                           ~ "other"
    )) 

```

pvalue with t test
```{r}
# Subset the data for the groups you're comparing
prolif_data <- histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_ez_de2 %>% 
  dplyr::filter(max_cat_exclude == "P0_P7") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(ensembl_gene_id %in% diff_genes$ensembl_gene_id | ensembl_gene_id %in% prolif_genes$ensembl_gene_id)

diff_data <- histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_ez_de2 %>% 
  dplyr::filter(max_cat_exclude == "P14_P56") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(ensembl_gene_id %in% diff_genes$ensembl_gene_id | ensembl_gene_id %in% prolif_genes$ensembl_gene_id)

# Perform a t-test
t_test_result <- t.test(prolif_data$EZH2_logFC, diff_data$EZH2_logFC)

# Extract the p-value
p_value <- t_test_result$p.value

```

```{r}


# Assuming you've already calculated the p-value
# Example comparison data
comparison_data <- data.frame(
  group1 = "P0_P7",
  group2 = "P14_P56",

  y.position = max(histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_ez_de2$EZH2_logFC) + 0.2  # Adjust this value based on your data
)

# Plot with p-value bracket

  scale_alpha_manual(values = ezh2_de_alpha) +

  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("P0_P7" = "Proliferation genes", "P14_P56" = "Differentiation genes")) +
```

```{r, fig.height= 4, fig.width= 4}
  tidyr::gather( variable, value, -HGNC_symbol_from_ensemblv77)   %>%
  tidyr::spread(HGNC_symbol_from_ensemblv77, value ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(., human_mb_clinical, by = c("variable" =  "Study_ID") ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Study_ID = variable) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Subgroup == "SHH" )  %>%
    dplyr::mutate(EZH2_cat = case_when( 
    Study_ID  %in%  Ezh2_top_bottom$ptn[Ezh2_top_bottom$EZH2_high_low == "Ezh2 low"]  ~ "EZH2 low",
    Study_ID  %in%  Ezh2_top_bottom$ptn[Ezh2_top_bottom$EZH2_high_low == "Ezh2 high"]  ~ "EZH2 high",
    TRUE   ~ "EZH2 mid"  
    )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = EZH2 , y = CBX7, shape =Subtype,  group = EZH2_cat, fill = EZH2_cat  )) +
      geom_mark_hull(
                 colour = NA,
                 alpha = 0.8,
                 expand = unit(2, "mm"), 
                 radius = unit(2, "mm"),
                 concavity =-5
                ) +
      geom_point() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = ezh2_tumor_cols) + 
    labs(x = "EZH2 RNA abundance", y = "CBX7 RNA Abundance") +
      theme_classic() + 
    theme(legend.position =  "none", 
          text = element_text(size = 16))
```

```{r, fig.width=5 , fig.height= 5}
diff_human_set <- histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_ez_de2 %>% 
  dplyr::filter(group_1 == "Dynically expressed in granule neuron lineage") %>%
  dplyr::filter(ensembl_gene_id %in% diff_genes$ensembl_gene_id | mgi_symbol == "Ezh2") %>% 
  dplyr::select( Probe.Set.Name)
  
  

shh_mb_samples <- human_mb_clinical %>%
  dplyr::filter(Subgroup == "SHH" ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Study_ID)



diff_genes_human_ezh2_MB <- human_mb_raw_all %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Probe.Set.Name %in% diff_human_set$Probe.Set.Name) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(HGNC_symbol_from_ensemblv77)) %>%
  dplyr::select(HGNC_symbol_from_ensemblv77, all_of(shh_mb_samples$Study_ID) ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(HGNC_symbol_from_ensemblv77, .keep_all = TRUE)


row.names(diff_genes_human_ezh2_MB) <- diff_genes_human_ezh2_MB$HGNC_symbol_from_ensemblv77
diff_genes_human_ezh2_MB$HGNC_symbol_from_ensemblv77 <- NULL

correlation_ezh2_MB_human <- cor(t(diff_genes_human_ezh2_MB))
correlation_ezh2_MB_human <- as.data.frame(correlation_ezh2_MB_human)
correlation_ezh2_MB_human$gene <- row.names(correlation_ezh2_MB_human)

correlation_ezh2_MB_human <- correlation_ezh2_MB_human %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, EZH2) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(GNP_group = "differentiation")


prolif_human_set <- histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_ez_de2 %>% 
  dplyr::filter(group_1 == "Dynically expressed in granule neuron lineage") %>%
  dplyr::filter(ensembl_gene_id %in% prolif_genes$ensembl_gene_id | mgi_symbol == "Ezh2") %>% 
  dplyr::select( Probe.Set.Name)
  
     

prolif_genes_human_ezh2_MB <- human_mb_raw_all %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Probe.Set.Name %in% prolif_human_set$Probe.Set.Name) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(HGNC_symbol_from_ensemblv77)) %>%
  dplyr::select(HGNC_symbol_from_ensemblv77, all_of(shh_mb_samples$Study_ID) ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(HGNC_symbol_from_ensemblv77, .keep_all = TRUE)
 

row.names(prolif_genes_human_ezh2_MB) <- prolif_genes_human_ezh2_MB$HGNC_symbol_from_ensemblv77
prolif_genes_human_ezh2_MB$HGNC_symbol_from_ensemblv77 <- NULL

prolif_correlation_ezh2_MB_human <- cor(t(prolif_genes_human_ezh2_MB))
prolif_correlation_ezh2_MB_human <- as.data.frame(prolif_correlation_ezh2_MB_human)
prolif_correlation_ezh2_MB_human$gene <- row.names(prolif_correlation_ezh2_MB_human)

prolif_correlation_ezh2_MB_human <- prolif_correlation_ezh2_MB_human %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, EZH2) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(GNP_group = "proliferation")


correlation_ezh2_MB_human <- rbind(correlation_ezh2_MB_human, prolif_correlation_ezh2_MB_human)

correlation_ezh2_MB_human <- correlation_ezh2_MB_human %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene != "EZH2")

hs_ezh2_de_genes_ez_low <- c("GABRA6", "CBX7", "PHYHIP", "ABLIM1", "CACNA1A","SLCL2A5", "GAS7" )
hs_ezh2_de_genes_ez_high <- c( "ATOH1", "MYCN","CDK2","TOP2A", "MELK","CCND2")


mean_correlation_ezh2_MB_human <- correlation_ezh2_MB_human %>%
  dplyr::group_by(GNP_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(EZH2 = mean(EZH2))

mean_correlation_ezh2_MB_human$GNP_group <- factor(mean_correlation_ezh2_MB_human$GNP_group, levels = c("proliferation", "differentiation"))

# Add jittered positions to the data frame
correlation_ezh2_MB_human_jittered <- correlation_ezh2_MB_human %>%
  mutate(jittered_x = jitter(as.numeric(as.factor(GNP_group)), amount = 0.4))

correlation_ezh2_MB_human_jittered$GNP_group <- factor(correlation_ezh2_MB_human_jittered$GNP_group, levels = c("proliferation", "differentiation"))

set.seed(42)
# Create the plot
ggplot(correlation_ezh2_MB_human_jittered, aes(x = GNP_group, y = EZH2)) + 
  geom_violin() +
  geom_point(aes(x = jittered_x, y = EZH2), size = 0.4, 
             colour = "azure4") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype='dotted') +
  geom_text_repel(data = correlation_ezh2_MB_human_jittered  %>% 
                    dplyr::filter(gene %in% c(hs_ezh2_de_genes_ez_low, hs_ezh2_de_genes_ez_high)),
                    aes(x = jittered_x, y = EZH2, label = gene), 
                  force = 30,
                  size = 5, 
                  box.padding = 1, 
                  #max.overlaps = Inf,
                  min.segment.length =	0.5, 
                  colour = "black") +
   geom_point(data = correlation_ezh2_MB_human_jittered  %>% 
                    dplyr::filter(gene %in% c(hs_ezh2_de_genes_ez_low, hs_ezh2_de_genes_ez_high)),
                    aes(x = jittered_x, y = EZH2, label = gene),
            shape = 1, 
            size = 4, 
            colour = "red") + 
  geom_point(data = mean_correlation_ezh2_MB_human, 
             aes(x = GNP_group, y = EZH2), 
              shape = 5, 
             size = 4, 
             colour = "blue") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("proliferation" = "Proliferation genes", "differentiation" = "Differentiation genes")) +
   labs(y = "Pearson corrleation compared to Ezh2", x = "GNP gene group") +
theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12),
        axis.title=element_text(size=12))
 


correlation_ezh2_MB_human %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% c("CBX7", "ABLIM1", "GAS7", "PHYHIP" ))
 
   
```

non normal distribution so use wilcoxian rank test 

```{r}
wilcox_test_result <- wilcox.test(EZH2 ~ GNP_group, data = correlation_ezh2_MB_human)

# View the results of the Wilcoxon test
wilcox_test_result


# Create a data frame for the comparison
p_value_df <- data.frame(
  group1 = "proliferation",
  group2 = "differentiation",
  y.position = max(correlation_ezh2_MB_human_jittered$EZH2, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.1,  # Adjust as needed for bracket position
  p = wilcox_test_result$p.value
)

p_value_df <- p_value_df %>%
  mutate(p = formatC(p, digits = 3, format = "e"))  # Scientific notation with 3 significant figures


# Set factor levels to ensure correct ordering in the plot
correlation_ezh2_MB_human_jittered$GNP_group <- factor(correlation_ezh2_MB_human_jittered$GNP_group, 
                                                       levels = c("proliferation", "differentiation"))

# Set the correct order for factor levels in correlation data
correlation_ezh2_MB_human_jittered <- correlation_ezh2_MB_human %>%
  mutate(GNP_group = factor(GNP_group, levels = c("proliferation", "differentiation")),
         jittered_x = ifelse(GNP_group == "proliferation", 1, 2) + runif(nrow(correlation_ezh2_MB_human), -0.4, 0.4))  # Jitter around 1 and 2

# Ensure correct ordering for mean data and set x-position manually
mean_correlation_ezh2_MB_human <- mean_correlation_ezh2_MB_human %>%
  mutate(GNP_group = factor(GNP_group, levels = c("proliferation", "differentiation")),
         x_position = ifelse(GNP_group == "proliferation", 1, 2))

# Generate the plot with the correct x-positions for jittered and mean points
cor_ezh2_mb_summary_plot <- ggplot(correlation_ezh2_MB_human_jittered, aes(x = GNP_group, y = EZH2)) + 
  geom_violin() +
  geom_point(aes(x = jittered_x, y = EZH2), size = 0.4, colour = "azure4") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dotted') +
  geom_text_repel(data = correlation_ezh2_MB_human_jittered %>% 
                    dplyr::filter(gene %in% c(hs_ezh2_de_genes_ez_low, hs_ezh2_de_genes_ez_high)),
                  aes(x = jittered_x, y = EZH2, label = gene), 
                  force = 30,
                  size = 5, 
                  box.padding = 1, 
                  min.segment.length = 0.5, 
                  colour = "black") +
  geom_point(data = correlation_ezh2_MB_human_jittered %>% 
               dplyr::filter(gene %in% c(hs_ezh2_de_genes_ez_low, hs_ezh2_de_genes_ez_high)),
             aes(x = jittered_x, y = EZH2, label = gene),
             shape = 1, 
             size = 4, 
             colour = "red") + 
  # Use x_position for mean points to align with categories
  geom_point(data = mean_correlation_ezh2_MB_human, 
             aes(x = x_position, y = EZH2), 
             shape = 18, 
             size = 4,
             fill = "blue",
             colour = "blue") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("proliferation" = "Proliferation genes", "differentiation" = "Differentiation genes")) +
  labs(y = "Pearson correlation compared to EZH2", x = "GNP gene group") +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(p_value_df, 
                     label = "p", 
                     xmin = "group1", 
                     xmax = "group2", 
                     y.position = "y.position", 
                     tip.length = 0.01)  # Adjust tip length for aesthetics

print(cor_ezh2_mb_summary_plot)
```

Does EZH2 expression level predict survival? 

```{r, fig.height= 3, fig.width= 4}

library(survminer)

SHH_clinical <- human_mb_clinical %>%
  dplyr::filter(Subgroup == "SHH") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Study_ID %in% Ezh2_top_bottom$ptn) %>%
  dplyr::rename(OS = `OS (years)`) %>%  # Corrected column name here
  # limit to 5 year mortality
  dplyr::mutate(OS = ifelse(OS >= 5, 5, OS)) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(Dead = ifelse(OS >= 5, 0, Dead)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(OS = ifelse(Dead == 0, 5, OS)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(OS = as.numeric(OS)) %>%

   dplyr::filter(!is.na(OS)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Dead))

SHH_clinical$EZH2 <- plyr::mapvalues(as.character(SHH_clinical$Study_ID), 
                                          from = as.character(Ezh2_top_bottom$ptn), 
                                          to = as.character(Ezh2_top_bottom$EZH2_high_low)) 

SHH_clinical$EZH2 <- gsub("Ezh2 ", "", SHH_clinical$EZH2)


table(is.na(SHH_clinical$Dead), is.na(SHH_clinical$OS))

SHH_clinical <- SHH_clinical %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Dead = as.factor(Dead)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(EZH2 = as.factor(EZH2)) 

SHH_clinical %>%
  filter(Dead == 1) %>%
  dplyr::select(Dead, OS)

SHH_clinical %>%
  filter(Dead == 1) %>%
    filter(OS == 5 ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Dead, OS)

SHH_clinical %>%
  filter(is.na(Dead)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Dead, OS)




require("survival")
fit<- survfit(Surv(OS, Dead) ~ EZH2, data = SHH_clinical)

# Basic survival curves
ggsurvplot(fit, data = SHH_clinical, 
            pval = TRUE)

```



Does EZH2 expression level predict survival? 

```{r, fig.height= 2.5, fig.width= 3}

max_year = 10 

SHH_clinical <- human_mb_clinical %>%
  dplyr::filter(Subgroup == "SHH") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Study_ID %in% Ezh2_top_bottom$ptn) %>%
  dplyr::rename(OS = `OS (years)`) %>%  # Corrected column name here
  # limit to 5 year mortality
  dplyr::mutate(OS = ifelse(OS >= max_year, max_year, OS)) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(Dead = ifelse(OS >= max_year, 0, Dead)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(OS = ifelse(Dead == 0, max_year, OS)) %>%
   dplyr::filter(!is.na(OS)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Dead))

SHH_clinical$EZH2 <- plyr::mapvalues(as.character(SHH_clinical$Study_ID), 
                                          from = as.character(Ezh2_top_bottom$ptn), 
                                          to = as.character(Ezh2_top_bottom$EZH2_high_low)) 

SHH_clinical$EZH2 <- gsub("Ezh2 ", "", SHH_clinical$EZH2)


table(is.na(SHH_clinical$Dead), is.na(SHH_clinical$OS))


require("survival")
fit<- survfit(Surv(OS, Dead) ~ EZH2, data = SHH_clinical)

# Basic survival curves
ggsurvplot(fit, data = SHH_clinical, 
            pval = TRUE, 
            risk.table = TRUE,
            tables.height = 0.2, 
            risk.table.pos = "in",
           xlab = "Time in years",
           palette = c("navajowhite4", "orange2"),
           legend = c(0.7, 0.3), 
           legend.title = "EZH2 transcript group"
            )
```
